S.PHON: panaj miʦaɾiwan is[o|u] k[o|u] pajʦi ni kaʦaw ħaw
S.TRANSL: Panay, did you borrow money from Kacaw?

S.FORM: Hai, o papatikolen no mako cira anini, matawalay no mako a mihawikid ko payci.
Hai, o papatikolen no mako cira anini, matawalay no mako a mihawikid ko payci.
S.PHON: ħai [o|u] papatik[o|u]ɾən n[o|u] mak[o|u] ʦira anini matawaɾaj n[o|u] mak[o|u] a miħawikiɬ k[o|u] pajʦi
S.TRANSL: 有，我本來今天要還他，我忘記帶錢了。
Yes, I was supposed to return to him today, but I forgot to bring the money.

S.FORM: Hacowa a patikolen no miso?
Hacowa a patikolen no miso?
S.PHON: ħaʦ[o|u]wa a patik[o|u]ɾən n[o|u] mis[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Then, when will you return the money?

S.FORM: Anocila hanto ako a patikol cira.
Anocila hanto ako a patikol cira.
S.PHON: an[o|u]ʦiɾa ħant[o|u] ak[o|u] a patik[o|u]ɾ ʦira
S.TRANSL: I will return to him tomorrow.

S.FORM: Hayda, sowal hanto ako ci Kacaw.
Hayda, sowal hanto ako ci Kacaw.
S.PHON: ħajɬa s[o|u]waɾ ħant[o|u] ak[o|u] ʦi kaʦaw
S.TRANSL: Okay, I will tell Kacaw for you.

S.FORM: O fakeloh ko sapi'enec to 'edo a mi'adop, o wa'il ko sapitalakal to tolok, matatodongay haenen.
O fakeloh ko sapi'enec to 'edo a mi'adop, o wa'il ko sapitalakal to tolok, matatodongay haenen.
S.PHON: [o|u] fakəɾ[o|u]ħ k[o|u] sapiʡənəʦ t[o|u] ʡəɬ[o|u] a miʡaɬ[o|u]p [o|u] waʡiɾ k[o|u] sapitaɾakaɾ t[o|u] t[o|u]ɾ[o|u]k matat[o|u]ɬ[o|u]ŋaj ħaənən
S.TRANSL: 老鼠應該要⽤⽯壓式陷阱抓，⽵雞應該要⽤套頸式陷阱抓，這樣才對。
It is correct to catch mice through rangay and catch bamboo partridges through qjiulang.

S.FORM: Mahaenay han, mararaway ko demak ako! Salaw awa ko ma'adpay no mako.
Mahaenay han, mararaway ko demak ako! Salaw awa ko ma'adpay no mako.
S.PHON: maħaənaj ħan mararawaj k[o|u] ɬəmak ak[o|u] saɾaw awa k[o|u] maʡaɬpaj n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 原來是這樣，我都搞錯了！難怪我都抓不到。
No wonder! I am mistaken and that’s why I cannot catch any of them.

S.FORM: Pakafana'en ho ako kiso misanga' tona tosa a satalakal.
Pakafana'en ho ako kiso misanga' tona tosa a satalakal.
S.PHON: pakafanaʡən ħ[o|u] ak[o|u] kis[o|u] misaŋaʡ t[o|u]na t[o|u]sa a sataɾakaɾ
S.TRANSL: 那我再教你怎麼製作這兩種陷阱。
Then I will teach you how to set up these two traps.

S.FORM: Hayda! Tadanga'ayay to! Ano miliyaw mi'adop haenen to ako a mitalakal nga' citama'.
Hayda! Tadanga'ayay to! Ano miliyaw mi'adop haenen to ako a mitalakal nga' citama'.
S.PHON: ħajɬa taɬaŋaʡajaj t[o|u] an[o|u] miɾijaw miʡaɬ[o|u]p ħaənən t[o|u] ak[o|u] a mitaɾakaɾ ŋaʡ ʦitamaʡ
S.TRANSL: 好啊！太棒了！這樣我以後就會抓到獵物了。
Great! I will be able to catch the prey in the future.

S.FORM: Alaen ko kawkaw i kofaw, tayra kita i omah mifariw to semot, 'akawangay to ko semot i omah.
Alaen ko kawkaw i kofaw, tayra kita i omah mifariw to semot, 'akawangay to ko semot i omah.
S.PHON: aɾaən k[o|u] kawkaw i k[o|u]faw tajra kita i [o|u]maħ mifariw t[o|u] səm[o|u]t ʡakawaŋaj t[o|u] k[o|u] səm[o|u]t i [o|u]maħ
S.TRANSL: 田裡的草太長了，你去倉庫拿鐮刀，我們去田裡。
The grass in the fields is too tall. Go to the warehouse to take the sickle and let’s go to the fields.

S.FORM: Icowaan miteli ko kawkaw?
Icowaan miteli ko kawkaw?
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]waan mitəɾi k[o|u] kawkaw

S.FORM: Itiraay i fati'ian no tanomal, comod sa kiso ma'araw to.
Itiraay i fati'ian no tanomal, comod sa kiso ma'araw to.
S.PHON: itiraaj i fatiʡian n[o|u] tan[o|u]maɾ ʦ[o|u]m[o|u]ɬ sa kis[o|u] maʡaraw t[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 在圓簍的旁邊，你進去倉庫就會看到了。
It is next to the round basket. You will see it when you enter the warehouse.

S.FORM: Na'onen miala, cihinangay ko kawkaw kiya!
Na'onen miala, cihinangay ko kawkaw kiya!
S.PHON: naʡ[o|u]nən miaɾa ʦiħinaŋaj k[o|u] kawkaw kija
S.TRANSL: 小心拿，不要受傷。鐮刀很利！
Be careful and don’t get hurt. The sickle is very sharp.

S.FORM: Aka ripa'en ko talakal ako!
Aka ripa'en ko talakal ako!
S.PHON: aka ripaʡən k[o|u] taɾakaɾ ak[o|u]

S.FORM: Icowaan iso miteli ko talakal iso?
Icowaan iso miteli ko talakal iso?
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]waan is[o|u] mitəɾi k[o|u] taɾakaɾ is[o|u]

S.FORM: I kaeno nora kilang ko talakal no mako.
I kaeno nora kilang ko talakal no mako.
S.PHON: i kaən[o|u] n[o|u]ra kiɾaŋ k[o|u] taɾakaɾ n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我的陷阱在那棵樹的下面。
My trap is under that tree.

S.FORM: Mana maharateng iso?
Mana maharateng iso?
S.PHON: mana maħaratəŋ is[o|u]

S.FORM: Ira ko nikonisan ako ini, mansa mafana' to kako, icowaan ako miteli ko talakal ako.
Ira ko nikonisan ako ini, mansa mafana' to kako, icowaan ako miteli ko talakal ako.
S.PHON: ira k[o|u] nik[o|u]nisan ak[o|u] ini mansa mafanaʡ t[o|u] kak[o|u] iʦ[o|u]waan ak[o|u] mitəɾi k[o|u] taɾakaɾ ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我在這邊有做記號知道我的陷阱在哪裡。
I make a mark here, so I know where my trap is.

S.FORM: O foefo koni, telien niyam i lawac no 'alo a mifoting.
O foefo koni, telien niyam i lawac no 'alo a mifoting.
S.PHON: [o|u] f[o|u]əf[o|u] k[o|u]ni təɾiən nijam i ɾawaʦ n[o|u] ʡaɾ[o|u] a mif[o|u]tiŋ
S.TRANSL: 這是魚筌，我們放在溪邊捕魚。
This is a fish trap which we put beside the river for fishing.

S.FORM: Awaay ko foefo tamiyanan, pacemot hananay ko pifoting i tamiyanan.
Awaay ko foefo tamiyanan, pacemot hananay ko pifoting i tamiyanan.
S.PHON: awaaj k[o|u] f[o|u]əf[o|u] tamijanan paʦəm[o|u]t ħananaj k[o|u] pif[o|u]tiŋ i tamijanan
S.TRANSL: 我們那邊沒有魚筌，我們都用釣竿抓魚。
We don’t have any fish traps there, so we catch fish with a fishing rod.

S.FORM: Ca ho pitanam kako a mipacemot, cila to pakafana' han to kako makena?
Ca ho pitanam kako a mipacemot, cila to pakafana' han to kako makena?
S.PHON: ʦa ħ[o|u] pitanam kak[o|u] a mipaʦəm[o|u]t ʦiɾa t[o|u] pakafanaʡ ħan t[o|u] kak[o|u] makəna
S.TRANSL: 我沒有用過釣竿，你下次教我好嗎?
I have never used a fishing rod before, would you mind teaching me next time?

S.FORM: Hayda, cila to lacafay sato kita a mipacemot.
Hayda, cila to lacafay sato kita a mipacemot.
S.PHON: ħajɬa ʦiɾa t[o|u] ɾaʦafaj sat[o|u] kita a mipaʦəm[o|u]t
S.TRANSL: 好啊!我們下次一起去釣魚。
Sure! Let’s go fishing together next time.

S.FORM: Liyaw to a romi'ad pakafana' han to ako kiso a misanga' to foefo.
Liyaw to a romi'ad pakafana' han to ako kiso a misanga' to foefo.

S.TRANSL: I will teach you how to make a fish trap next time.

S.FORM: Tatemikay to ko sapacemot iso, mapacemotay to ko foting alatek, halikien a mitengteng.
Tatemikay to ko sapacemot iso, mapacemotay to ko foting alatek, halikien a mitengteng.

S.TRANSL: 你的釣竿動了，是不是有魚上鉤了!你快拉起來。
Your fishing rod is moving. Isn’t the fish on the hook? Pull it up!

S.FORM: Aka ho, ngiyangi sanay ko tamina. Itini sa kako mitengteng to sapacemot, patadoen ho kako miala to salil itira.
Aka ho, ngiyangi sanay ko tamina. Itini sa kako mitengteng to sapacemot, patadoen ho kako miala to salil itira.
S.PHON: aka ħ[o|u] ŋijaŋi sanaj k[o|u] tamina itini sa kak[o|u] mitəŋtəŋ t[o|u] sapaʦəm[o|u]t pataɬ[o|u]ən ħ[o|u] kak[o|u] miaɾa t[o|u] saɾiɾ itira
S.TRANSL: 等等，船太晃了。我在這邊拉釣竿，你去那邊幫我拿網子來。
Wait, the ship is rolling heavily. I am here to pull the fishing rod and you should go there to grab me the net.

S.FORM: Tengtengen patayni kora foting, patadoen no mako kiso a mitengteng.
Tengtengen patayni kora foting, patadoen no mako kiso a mitengteng.
S.PHON: təŋtəŋən patajni k[o|u]ra f[o|u]tiŋ pataɬ[o|u]ən n[o|u] mak[o|u] kis[o|u] a mitəŋtəŋ
S.TRANSL: 你把魚拉到我這邊。我幫妳拉起來。
Pull the fish to my side and I will help you pull it up.

S.FORM: Wata! Makadofah anini, tomes sanay ko faroro.
Wata! Makadofah anini, tomes sanay ko faroro.
S.PHON: wata makaɬ[o|u]faħ anini t[o|u]məs sanaj k[o|u] far[o|u]r[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 太好了!今天大豐收，魚簍都裝滿了。
Great! It is a bumper crop today with full fish baskets.

S.FORM: Halikien a minokay palilamen no mita ko salawinawina.
Halikien a minokay palilamen no mita ko salawinawina.
S.PHON: ħaɾikiən a min[o|u]kaj paɾiɾamən n[o|u] mita k[o|u] saɾawinawina
S.TRANSL: 我們快回去和大家分享。
Let’s go back immediately and share it with everyone.

S.FORM: Iraay to ko singsi.
Iraay to ko singsi.
S.PHON: iraaj t[o|u] k[o|u] siŋsi

Aka to pisalama, Kamaro' to i hakenang.

S.TRANSL: 不要再玩了，快坐在座位上。
Stop playing and quickly sit in your seat.

S.FORM: Kangodo'an, masosoyay kako!
Kangodo'an, masosoyay kako!
S.PHON: kaŋ[o|u]ɬ[o|u]ʡan mas[o|u]s[o|u]jaj kak[o|u]

S.FORM: Micomod to.
Micomod to.
S.PHON: miʦ[o|u]m[o|u]ɬ t[o|u]

O sakapina no mitiliday anini?
S.PHON: [o|u] sakapina n[o|u] mitiɾiɬaj anini

S.FORM: O sakalima, Pahanhan anocila, malacafay kita a misalama!
O sakalima, Pahanhan anocila, malacafay kita a misalama!
S.PHON: [o|u] sakaɾima paħanħan an[o|u]ʦiɾa maɾaʦafaj kita a misaɾama
S.TRANSL: 今天星期五，明天放假，一起出去玩吧!
It’s Friday today, we have a day off tomorrow. Let’s go out and play together!

Hayda! Tala'alo kita.
S.PHON: ħajɬa taɾaʡaɾ[o|u] kita
S.TRANSL: Great! Let’s go to the riverside.

O sakapina no mitiliday anocila?
S.PHON: [o|u] sakapina n[o|u] mitiɾiɬaj an[o|u]ʦiɾa
S.TRANSL: What day will it be tomorrow?

O sakatolo anocila, Misalama kita to mali anocila to ikor no kalahokan!
S.PHON: [o|u] sakat[o|u]ɾ[o|u] an[o|u]ʦiɾa misaɾama kita t[o|u] maɾi an[o|u]ʦiɾa t[o|u] ik[o|u]r n[o|u] kaɾaħ[o|u]kan
S.TRANSL: 明天星期三，我們明天下午去玩球吧!
Tomorrow will be Wednesday. Let’s go play ball tomorrow afternoon!

S.FORM: Mimaan kiso anopapacem?
Mimaan kiso anopapacem?
S.PHON: mimaan kis[o|u] an[o|u]papaʦəm
S.TRANSL: What will you be doing tomorrow morning?

O pa'aliwacan anocila, O tatayra kako ato ina ako i kiwkay.
S.PHON: [o|u] paʡaɾiwaʦan an[o|u]ʦiɾa [o|u] tatajra kak[o|u] at[o|u] ina ak[o|u] i kiwkaj
S.TRANSL: 明天是星期日，我要和媽媽去教會。
Tomorrow will be Sunday, I will be going to church with my mom.

Mamaanay kiso?

Saka'otaaw sanay kako, Tayra ho kako i tata'iyan.

S.TRANSL: I feel like vomiting. I need to go to the restroom.

Lasang sanay ko fongoh ako.
S.PHON: ɾasaŋ sanaj k[o|u] f[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ħ ak[o|u]

Hinefa sa ho kiso a pahanhan.

Singsi, adadaay ko tiyad ako, Tayra ho kako i tata'iyan.

S.TRANSL: 老師，我肚子痛，要去廁所。
Teacher, I have a stomachache. I need to go to the restroom.

Hayda, halikien a tayra.

Nga'ay a misawsaw kako to kamay haw?

Papahanhan to, anohoni to a tayra.

S.TRANSL: It’s almost time for class to end. Wait a little longer.

Singsi, adada sanay ko fongoh ako, Pahanhan kako i ikor no kalahokan.

It’s almost time for class to end. Wait a little longer.

Hayda, na'onen ko rakat a minokay.

S.TRANSL: Okay, take care and go home.

Singsi, papahanhan kako anocila sakacecay no mitiliday, O papaising kako.

Teacher, I need to take a sick leave next Monday. I have to see a doctor.

Hayda, Sanga'ayen to ko tireng.

Icowaay ci Kacaw?

Singsi, adadaay ko takolaw ni Kacaw, Pahanhanay anini.

Mana awa ci Panay?

Malalisanay cira.

Siwkayen ho ko tireng iso.

Si Caki kako, Moetepay to ko mihecaan ako.

Si Caki ko ngangan no mako.

O maan ko finacadan no miso?

O wawa no 'Amis kako.

Saheto o Yencomin ko paro no loma' namo haw?

Are all your family members indigenous?

Hai, saheto o 'Amis ko paro no loma' niyam.

Yes, my whole family is Amis.

S.PHON: an[o|u] ħatira i tajra kita i səfi siʦaəɬ[o|u]ŋ kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 那去聚會所好了，我會穿族服去。
Then let’s go to the community center. I’ll wear folk costume.

S.FORM: Makapahay ko sakora a hana no niyaro'. Yo macelak ko hana i, kilimen kako haw!
Makapahay ko sakora a hana no niyaro'. Yo macelak ko hana i, kilimen kako haw!
S.PHON: makapaħaj k[o|u] sak[o|u]ra a ħana n[o|u] nijar[o|u]ʡ j[o|u] maʦəɾak k[o|u] ħana i kiɾimən kak[o|u] ħaw
S.TRANSL: 我們部落的櫻花盛開很漂亮。等花開的時候你來找我吧!
The cherry blossoms in our tribe are beautiful when they bloom. Come find me when the flowers bloom!

S.FORM: Tahira i kacanglahan, maosoyay tato!
Tahira i kacanglahan, maosoyay tato!
S.PHON: taħira i kaʦaŋɾaħan ma[o|u]s[o|u]jaj tat[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 那要等到春天，太晚了吧!
That would have to wait until spring. It’s too late, isn’t it?

S.FORM: Ano hatira i, i kiloma'an kiso a tayni!
Ano hatira i, i kiloma'an kiso a tayni!
S.PHON: an[o|u] ħatira i i kiɾ[o|u]maʡan kis[o|u] a tajni
S.TRANSL: 那你豐年祭的時候來吧!
Then come during our Harvest Festival!

S.FORM: Hayda! Hinatala ko faloco' ako!
Hayda! Hinatala ko faloco' ako!
S.PHON: ħajɬa ħinataɾa k[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: Alright! I’m looking forward to it!

S.FORM: Mana malinah a minokay kiso i niyaro' a maro'?
Mana malinah a minokay kiso i niyaro' a maro'?
S.PHON: mana maɾinaħ a min[o|u]kaj kis[o|u] i nijar[o|u]ʡ a mar[o|u]ʡ
S.TRANSL: 請問你為甚麼要搬回部落生活?
May I ask why you decided to move back to the tribe?

S.FORM: Minokay pakafana' kako to tilid.
Minokay pakafana' kako to tilid.
S.PHON: min[o|u]kaj pakafanaʡ kak[o|u] t[o|u] tiɾiɬ
S.TRANSL: I want to return to teach at the local school.

S.FORM: Mana cowa kaitokay a pakafana'?
Mana cowa kaitokay a pakafana'?
S.PHON: mana ʦ[o|u]wa kait[o|u]kaj a pakafanaʡ
S.TRANSL: Why not teach in the city?

S.FORM: Naw han i, ma'ololay kako to niyaro' ako, miharateng haca paco'ay to niyaro'.
Naw han i, ma'ololay kako to niyaro' ako, miharateng haca paco'ay to niyaro'.
S.PHON: naw ħan i maʡ[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ɾaj kak[o|u] t[o|u] nijar[o|u]ʡ ak[o|u] miħaratəŋ ħaʦa paʦ[o|u]ʡaj t[o|u] nijar[o|u]ʡ
S.TRANSL: 因為我懷念我的故鄉，也希望能回饋部落。
Because I miss my hometown and I also want to give back to the tribe.

S.FORM: Mafana' kiso a mitenooy, cima ko pakfana'ay i tisowanan?
Mafana' kiso a mitenooy, cima ko pakfana'ay i tisowanan?
S.PHON: mafanaʡ kis[o|u] a mitən[o|u][o|u]j ʦima k[o|u] pakfanaʡaj i tis[o|u]wanan
S.TRANSL: 你很會織布，是誰教你的?
You’re very skilled at weaving, who taught you?

S.FORM: O fofo ako. O samafana'ay a mitenooy i niyaro' cira.
O fofo ako. O samafana'ay a mitenooy i niyaro' cira.
S.PHON: [o|u] f[o|u]f[o|u] ak[o|u] [o|u] samafanaʡaj a mitən[o|u][o|u]j i nijar[o|u]ʡ ʦira
S.TRANSL: 是我的奶奶，她是我們部落最會織布的人。
It was my grandmother, she is the most skilled weaver in our tribe.

S.FORM: Mana miharateng a minanam a mitenooy kiso?
Mana miharateng a minanam a mitenooy kiso?
S.PHON: mana miħaratəŋ a minanam a mitən[o|u][o|u]j kis[o|u]
S.TRANSL: How did you develop an interest in learning weaving?

S.FORM: O serangawan ita ko tenooy, sapipatenakaw kako to serangawan ita.
O serangawan ita ko tenooy, sapipatenakaw kako to serangawan ita.
S.PHON: [o|u] səraŋawan ita k[o|u] tən[o|u][o|u]j sapipatənakaw kak[o|u] t[o|u] səraŋawan ita
S.TRANSL: 織布是我們的文化，我想要讓文化延續。
Weaving is a part of our culture, and I want to ensure its continuity.

S.FORM: Sanga'ay sa a nanomen kona epah.
Sanga'ay sa a nanomen kona epah.
S.PHON: saŋaʡaj sa a nan[o|u]mən k[o|u]na əpaħ

S.FORM: Kako ko misaepahay yo!
Kako ko misaepahay yo!
S.PHON: kak[o|u] k[o|u] misaəpaħaj j[o|u]

S.FORM: Tadaidahiyay to kiso, halafinay a misanga' tona epah haw?
Tadaidahiyay to kiso, halafinay a misanga' tona epah haw?
S.PHON: taɬaiɬaħijaj t[o|u] kis[o|u] ħaɾafinaj a misaŋaʡ t[o|u]na əpaħ ħaw
S.TRANSL: 你真厲害，這要釀很久嗎?
You’re really talented. Does it take a long time to make?

S.FORM: Cowa kahalafin. Maedeng cecay a lipay nga'ayay to. Rahekaden ho ko doway ato felac, palamlamen to otong a mitiyol nga, nga'ayay to a paroen i koreng.
Cowa kahalafin. Maedeng cecay a lipay nga'ayay to. Rahekaden ho ko doway ato felac, palamlamen to otong a mitiyol nga, nga'ayay to a paroen i koreng.
S.PHON: ʦ[o|u]wa kaħaɾafin maəɬəŋ ʦəʦaj a ɾipaj ŋaʡajaj t[o|u] raħəkaɬən ħ[o|u] k[o|u] ɬ[o|u]waj at[o|u] fəɾaʦ paɾamɾamən t[o|u] [o|u]t[o|u]ŋ a mitij[o|u]ɾ ŋa ŋaʡajaj t[o|u] a par[o|u]ən i k[o|u]rəŋ
S.TRANSL: 不用，大約一周就好了。把糯米和白米先蒸熟，再加入麴粉一起拌勻，就可以裝到甕裡了。
No, it only takes about a week. After steaming the sticky rice and white rice, we mix it with yeast powder, and then it can be stored in a jar.

S.FORM: O maan ko mipaliwalan iso?
O maan ko mipaliwalan iso?
S.PHON: [o|u] maan k[o|u] mipaɾiwaɾan is[o|u]

S.FORM: Ira ko 'adiyamay ato lokiw. Saheto o mipalomaan ako yo!
Ira ko 'adiyamay ato lokiw. Saheto o mipalomaan ako yo!
S.PHON: ira k[o|u] ʡaɬijamaj at[o|u] ɾ[o|u]kiw saħət[o|u] [o|u] mipaɾ[o|u]maan ak[o|u] j[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我這裡有辣椒和蕗蕎，都是我自己種的喔!
I have chili and lokiy, both grown by myself!

S.FORM: Tosa ko mi'acaan, pina ko 'aca?
Tosa ko mi'acaan, pina ko 'aca?
S.PHON: t[o|u]sa k[o|u] miʡaʦaan pina k[o|u] ʡaʦa

S.FORM: Tosa so'ot lima polo' ira ko lima a limood.
Tosa so'ot lima polo' ira ko lima a limood.
S.PHON: t[o|u]sa s[o|u]ʡ[o|u]t ɾima p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʡ ira k[o|u] ɾima a ɾim[o|u][o|u]ɬ

S.FORM: Maolah kako tona riko', pina ko 'aca nira?
Maolah kako tona riko', pina ko 'aca nira?
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] t[o|u]na rik[o|u]ʡ pina k[o|u] ʡaʦa nira
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡這件衣服，多少錢?
I like this piece of clothing. How much is it?

S.FORM: Lima so'ot a limood koni a riko'.
Lima so'ot a limood koni a riko'.
S.PHON: ɾima s[o|u]ʡ[o|u]t a ɾim[o|u][o|u]ɬ k[o|u]ni a rik[o|u]ʡ

S.FORM: 'Atekakay, cowa kanga'ay a lowanen to mamang haw?
'Atekakay, cowa kanga'ay a lowanen to mamang haw?
S.PHON: ʡatəkakaj ʦ[o|u]wa kaŋaʡaj a ɾ[o|u]wanən t[o|u] mamaŋ ħaw
S.TRANSL: It’s too expensive. Can’t you lower the price a bit?

S.FORM: Cowa kanga'ay, ano lowanen i, masiponay kako.
Cowa kanga'ay, ano lowanen i, masiponay kako.
S.PHON: ʦ[o|u]wa kaŋaʡaj an[o|u] ɾ[o|u]wanən i masip[o|u]naj kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: No, if I lower it further, I’ll lose money.

S.FORM: Hayda, ora kohetingay ko 'a'acaen ako.
Hayda, ora kohetingay ko 'a'acaen ako.
S.PHON: ħajɬa [o|u]ra k[o|u]ħətiŋaj k[o|u] ʡaʡaʦaən ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 好吧!那我要一件黑色的衣服。
Alright then, I’ll take a black piece of clothing.

S.FORM: Mi'aca kako toni po'ot ato inian a dangah.
Mi'aca kako toni po'ot ato inian a dangah.
S.PHON: miʡaʦa kak[o|u] t[o|u]ni p[o|u]ʡ[o|u]t at[o|u] inian a ɬaŋaħ
S.TRANSL: 我要買這把刀和這個鍋子。
I want this knife and this pot.

S.FORM: Polong han tosa lefot a limood. O misanga'an ako koni, o hahalafin a sakadademak.
Polong han tosa lefot a limood. O misanga'an ako koni, o hahalafin a sakadademak.
S.PHON: p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ŋ ħan t[o|u]sa ɾəf[o|u]t a ɾim[o|u][o|u]ɬ [o|u] misaŋaʡan ak[o|u] k[o|u]ni [o|u] ħaħaɾafin a sakaɬaɬəmak
S.TRANSL: 總共2000元，這是我自己手工打造的，保證可以用很久。
It’s a total of 2000 dollars. I handmade these, and they are guaranteed to last a long time.

S.FORM: Siwkayen ako ko widang a mi'aca, nga'ay kaemeden to mamang haw?
Siwkayen ako ko widang a mi'aca, nga'ay kaemeden to mamang haw?
S.PHON: siwkajən ak[o|u] k[o|u] wiɬaŋ a miʡaʦa ŋaʡaj kaəməɬən t[o|u] mamaŋ ħaw
S.TRANSL: 我介紹朋友來買，可以再便宜一些嗎?
I’ll introduce my friend to buy. Can you give a further discount?

S.FORM: Hayda! Papiteken ako to falo ko 'aca.
Hayda! Papiteken ako to falo ko 'aca.
S.PHON: ħajɬa papitəkən ak[o|u] t[o|u] faɾ[o|u] k[o|u] ʡaʦa
S.TRANSL: Alright! I’ll give you a 20% discount.

S.FORM: Katayni a minengneng! Ira ko riko' ato kafong itini.
Katayni a minengneng! Ira ko riko' ato kafong itini.
S.PHON: katajni a minəŋnəŋ ira k[o|u] rik[o|u]ʡ at[o|u] kaf[o|u]ŋ itini
S.TRANSL: 來看看喔!衣服帽子都有賣。
Come and take a look! We sell clothes and hats.

S.FORM: Licayaw ho, pinaay ko 'aca noni riko'?
Licayaw ho, pinaay ko 'aca noni riko'?
S.PHON: ɾiʦajaw ħ[o|u] pinaaj k[o|u] ʡaʦa n[o|u]ni rik[o|u]ʡ

S.FORM: Tolo so'ot lima polo' ko 'aca no cecay, hatolo han i, molefot ko 'aca.
Tolo so'ot lima polo' ko 'aca no cecay, hatolo han i, molefot ko 'aca.
S.PHON: t[o|u]ɾ[o|u] s[o|u]ʡ[o|u]t ɾima p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʡ k[o|u] ʡaʦa n[o|u] ʦəʦaj ħat[o|u]ɾ[o|u] ħan i m[o|u]ɾəf[o|u]t k[o|u] ʡaʦa
S.TRANSL: One piece of clothing is 350 dollars, three pieces for 1000 dollars.

S.FORM: Cecay aca ko mi'acaan ako, pafelien kako to faelohay.
Cecay aca ko mi'acaan ako, pafelien kako to faelohay.
S.PHON: ʦəʦaj aʦa k[o|u] miʡaʦaan ak[o|u] pafəɾiən kak[o|u] t[o|u] faəɾ[o|u]ħaj
S.TRANSL: 我買一件就好，請給我新的。
I’ll just buy one piece, please give me a new one.

S.FORM: Nga'ay ho, mi'aca kako to hakhak ato siimocay a titi.
Nga'ay ho, mi'aca kako to hakhak ato siimocay a titi.
S.PHON: ŋaʡaj ħ[o|u] miʡaʦa kak[o|u] t[o|u] ħakħak at[o|u] siim[o|u]ʦaj a titi
S.TRANSL: 你好，我想要買糯米飯和山胡椒滷肉。
Hello, I would like to buy sticky rice and braised pork with maqaw pepper.

S.FORM: Maeminay to ko hemay. Iraay ho ko sitana'ay a yu-ping, mi'aca kiso?
Maeminay to ko hemay. Iraay ho ko sitana'ay a yo-ping, mi'aca kiso?
S.PHON: maəminaj t[o|u] k[o|u] ħəmaj iraaj ħ[o|u] k[o|u] sitanaʡaj a j[o|u]piŋ miʡaʦa kis[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 飯賣完了。我還有刺蔥油餅，你要買嗎?
The rice is sold out. I have tana pancakes, would you like to buy them?

S.FORM: Hayda! Pafelien kako to cecay, cila to nga, mi'aca kako to hemay.
Hayda! Pafelien kako to cecay, cila to nga, mi'aca kako to hemay.
S.PHON: ħajɬa pafəɾiən kak[o|u] t[o|u] ʦəʦaj ʦiɾa t[o|u] ŋa miʡaʦa kak[o|u] t[o|u] ħəmaj
S.TRANSL: 好吧!請給我一份，我下次再來買飯。
Alright, please give me one. I’ll come back next time to buy rice.

S.FORM: Hay, padangen ako kiso a miparo i kalasay. Lima polo' a limood ko 'aca.
Hay, padangen ako kiso a miparo i kalasay. Lima polo' a limood ko 'aca.
S.PHON: ħaj paɬaŋən ak[o|u] kis[o|u] a mipar[o|u] i kaɾasaj ɾima p[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʡ a ɾim[o|u][o|u]ɬ k[o|u] ʡaʦa
S.TRANSL: W：好，我幫你用袋子裝起來，這樣50元。
Okay, I’ll pack it in a bag for you. That’ll be 50 dollars.
